name: Yamaha Venture (XVZ12 / XVZ13)
engine: 1198 or 1294 cc liquid-cooled V4, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's first big V4 tourer. Four carbs in the V, a lot of plastic, and a shaft drive.

G: The carbs sit in the V of the engine. Plan for the time it takes to get to them, and rebuild them as a set.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
